turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m here for my annual blood pressure check. I have hypertension and knee osteoarthritis, and I sometimes take acetaminophen for occasional knee pain.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or in the whites of my eyes. I’ve just been dealing with occasional knee pain, and nothing else unusual.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints when you wake up in the morning? If yes, does it usually improve after you start moving around?
turns.patient_answer: “Sometimes my knees feel a bit stiff when I first wake up, but it generally eases after I start moving around and getting going.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been confused or having trouble thinking clearly, and I feel oriented like usual. I haven’t noticed any changes in understanding what’s going on.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having night sweats—waking up during the night with your clothes or bedding noticeably damp—at least a few times recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any night sweats or waking up with damp clothes or bedding.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or swelling inside your thigh muscle (not just on the skin), especially one that’s getting bigger or feels painful?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any firm lump or swelling in my thigh muscles, and I don’t feel any unusual pain there—just the occasional knee discomfort.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions or unusual spots along the veins on your arm (for example, along the inner arm where veins are more visible)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any unusual skin lesions or spots along the veins on my arms, and I don’t see anything that looks out of the ordinary.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever worked in a job where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, battery work, or working in a foundry or metal shop?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t worked in jobs like welding, grinding, or anything involving metal dust or fumes. I haven’t had any battery or foundry-type work either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling or enlargement around your joints that feels bony or hard (for example in the fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any hard, bony swelling or enlargement around my joints—my knee discomfort is occasional, but I haven’t seen any obvious new hard lumps.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have pain in your thigh (either one or both thighs)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain in either thigh—it's mainly just the occasional knee pain.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this—can I ask: **do you experience pain or discomfort during sex (either at the vaginal opening or deeper inside)?**
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain or discomfort during sex. I haven’t noticed any issues related to that.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any scattered skin lesions or spots on your body (for example, small bumps, patches, or sores in different areas)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any scattered skin lesions or unusual spots or sores on my body. I’ve just been dealing with the occasional knee pain related to my arthritis.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you (or the person you’re caring for) seems unusually restless, irritable, or unable to stay calm—more than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been unusually restless or irritable, and I’m generally able to stay calm like I normally do. The only issue I’ve been noticing is occasional knee pain from my arthritis.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. **Are you having chest pain right now** (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not having chest pain right now. I’ve been feeling okay aside from my occasional knee discomfort.”
